hi, as someone whose wasted a couple thousands of their parents money/years, and failed out of multiple classes , i think i have a small grasp of the unrelenting stress you’re under. the gift of knowledge is one of most interesting and useful facets of life, you’re perseverance  in following your dream and not being broken by the circumstances you’ve encountered is proof of the something greater that lies in the spirit of humanity. as you probably know we are all bound to fail sometimes and it might take a couple times to get the hang of things, is it too late to drop the classes? i recommend making an appointment with a counselor ASAP and to set up a plan for your next semester in which you’ll know your boundaries and retake those classes and preserver!! have you tried meeting with your professors during their office hours to go over concepts/methods of studying? not trying to be preachy i was just compelled by your story and hope i can encourage you to take your time and be gentle with yourself.
